text_block_list.name: Young Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Hmph! Hnnngh...! ...Guh...

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi's Older Sister
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, Tsu-chan's completely exhausted. 
What's up, doing sit-ups all of a sudden?

text_block_list.name: Young Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
I mean, when I went to the training club 
the other day, someone beat my time, 
y'know.

text_block_list.name: Young Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
—I'm all fired up! I won't be left in the 
dust!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Happy New Year~!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Oh, welcome back. Is your visit back home 
over already?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. I was already planning to run in a 
race right after the new year. And 
besides—

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Where's Tsuru-chan? I was so looking 
forward to our ozoni party today.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
She said she has some errands to run. So 
she told me to eat her share of the ozoni 
too~

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Why do you, a Miho dorm resident, Sky-san, 
know so much about Ritto's affairs...? 
Don't tell me you're up to something weird 
again—

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha. Come on everyone, line up~. Doesn't 
matter which team you're on, any hungry 
girl is welcome♪

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Okaaay. The Ritto dorm leader is so 
generous~♪ King, I'm gonna leave you 
behind, okay~?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Ah, wait a minute!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Um...

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Hm? Bright, what's the matter? Are you 
having some trouble?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
No, it's not really a problem~ It's just 
about the ozoni~

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: *Yaaawn*――...achoo!

text_block_list.name: School Nurse
text_block_list.text:
"Oh my. You shouldn't have had a fever, 
but... Let me check your throat just in 
case, shall I?"

text_block_list.name: School Nurse
text_block_list.text:
I'll examine it all together with your 
legs.
choice_data_list:
Thank you for having me, even right at New 
Year's.

text_block_list.name: School Nurse
text_block_list.text:
Not at all. The infirmary is open from 
this time of year specifically for the 
Umamusume, after all.

"We will decide on entering races based on 
her condition each week." That policy 
continued even after the new year began.

Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi's condition is still 
too unstable. ...We haven't been able to 
set a major goal yet.
choice_data_list:
(Even though actions are being taken to 
improve things...)

text_block_list.text:
I poured over research papers, searched 
the web all day long, and tested every 
potential remedy for cases similar to 
hers. Yet, no ray of hope appeared.

Was the cause a failure to reach the 
proper preventive measures? And was that 
because I, as her Trainer, didn't have the 
right information?

While we're also seeking guidance from the 
school nurse... it's difficult to have her 
watch over us constantly.

What we can do right now is create a 
regimen reflecting yesterday's condition 
and observe the changes little by little.

"...I refuse to believe things can stay 
like this. We have to take far more 
drastic action――!"

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: ...-saaan. Trainer-saaan?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Here you go~, there's ozoni for you as 
well, Trainer-sama~
And then, I was given some ozoni.
choice_data_list: No, wait, what do you mean!?

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
A-Ahaha~. The truth is, Bright-san 
suddenly showed up a little while ago...

Mejiro Bright. She is an easygoing young 
lady of the Mejiro lineage and Tsurumaru 
Tsuyoshi's roommate.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
It's New Year's, after all~♪ I wanted to 
eat mochi with Lady Tsuru-chan, too~♪

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. Thank you. This ozoni... Right. 
Today is Ritto's...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
It's an ozoni party~. We're having a party 
in this room too~♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. Everyone joining in halfway, gather 
'round~.

text_block_list.name: Voice from the Hallway
text_block_list.text:
"Aww, I could've carried that for you~" 
"It's fine! I can at least help this 
much..." "Ah, we're almost there! Right 
over—"

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Tsuru-chaaan! Here is the Ritto Special 
Ozouni—

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: H-Huh, everyone else too!? Why...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
That's my line! I thought for sure I was 
all alone in the infirmary...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Well, color me surprised. Man, to think 
Bright-san beat me to the punch!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Well, now that everyone's got their share, 
let's eat. Trainers too. Before it gets 
cold.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Y-Yeah!

Taking a sip of the untouched ozoni. From 
the tip of the tongue, warmth and the rich 
flavor of bonito gradually spread—

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Hehe... Yeah. ...It's delicious.

text_block_list.name: School Nurse
text_block_list.text: ...Hehe.

text_block_list.name: School Nurse
text_block_list.text:
There are so many Umamusume around you who 
just want to pull you into their circle, 
Tsurumaru-san.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Because we're friends!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
"We can spend the seasons together, and 
run together. Because we're friends!"

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: ...! Spe-chan, everyone...

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
U-Uuuu~...! Tsuyoshi is so, so moved! To 
receive such kindness from everyone—

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
"Please let me return the favor! With a 
very special... Tsuyoshi Special Drink!"

text_block_list.name: Tsuyoshi's Classmates
text_block_list.text: "Huh. Ehh... Ah~, well, that's~..."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
My, Tsuru-chan-sama's special mix, is it~? 
All for the sake of one's health~.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Today's ingredients are~ nutrition 
comes first, so honey, mackerel, natto, 
green onions, garlic... and then chili 
peppers...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Man, I really, really love Hachimi. 
Yup, yup, love it, loooove it~.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
K-King prefers foods with a clear theme! 
If it's spicy, go all spicy! If it's 
sweet, go all sweet!!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Is that so? Then... hmm... taking 
everything into account...?
choice_data_list:
What I want to drink is that power-packed 
special drink!!

A slightly spicy drink to spark some 
ideas?

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
—I knew it! The theme will firmly be 
"Health" and nothing else!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
"Because I want everyone to spend their 
time full of energy too!!"

text_block_list.name: School Nurse
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha... By the way, how many servings is 
that drink for...?
(Ring-ring! Ring-ring!)

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Mm-hmm-hmm! I agree, I totally agree!! 
Tasty and healthy! That's the way to go!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Understood!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
In that case, honey and... mackerel, the 
pinnacle of health, please!!

text_block_list.name: School Nurse
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha... By the way, how many servings is 
that drink for...?
(Ring-ring! Ring-ring!)

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: ...King~.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Wha—what's that supposed to mean?! I was 
just trying to get the wind to blow in our 
favor...!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: ...I'm okay, everyone.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
“—Bring it on, Tsuru-chan! My stomach is 
invincible!!”

text_block_list.name: School Nurse
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha... By the way, how many servings is 
that drink for...?
(Ring-ring! Ring-ring!)

text_block_list.name: School Nurse
text_block_list.text:
Aah, shoot, I'm being summoned~~! Sorry, 
don't count me in~~!
(Patter-patter-patter...!)

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Oh dear... but it can't be helped, right? 
After all, she's the school infirmary 
doctor.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
It's not as if they can look after only us 
all the time.
choice_data_list:
I'd be really happy if we could do that, 
though.

I'd be really glad if we could do that, 
though.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
In that case, how about hiring a 'personal 
physician'~?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Yes. The Mejiro family has a personal 
physician who tends exclusively to Mejiro 
Umamusume~.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Ohh... As expected of a Mejiro daughter... 
Skipping right past family doctor straight 
to a personal physician...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Ho-ho~n...? Hey, Tsuru-chan. Your Trainer 
seems to be doing something—

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Yours too, Trainer! I've prepared 
health drinks for everyone!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe. All righty, I'll hand them out! 
Mine goes last and—alright!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Now then, hands together once more! Time 
to dig in—!!

And so, a New Year full of discoveries, 
surprises, and boundless energy was spent 
with Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi and the others.
